cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Which job offer did you secretly want me to accept?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Before you knew which one made me happy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because I haven't told you what I chose, and this is our last unbiased minute.
